title: Integrative multi-omics and genomic prediction reveal genetic basis of salt tolerance in alfalfa.
authors: He, Fei; Xu, Ming; Long, Ruicai; Zhu, Kai; Du, Mengrui; Ma, Wenqi; Xue, Hui; Peng, Yanling; Chen, Lin; Kang, Junmei; Zhou, Yongfeng; Yang, Qingchuan; Zhang, Fan
journal: Journal of genetics and genomics = Yi chuan xue bao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与机器学习预测苜蓿耐盐性遗传基础，虽涉及转录因子但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法为基因组预测而非AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The genetic basis of early-stage salt tolerance in alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.), a key factor limiting its productivity, remains poorly understood. To dissect this complex trait, we integrate genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and transcriptomics from 176 accessions within a machine learning based genomic prediction framework. Analysis reveals weak genetic correlations among four salt-tolerance traits and a gradual decline in performance under increasing salt stress. GWAS identify 60 significant associated SNPs, with the highest number detected under 100 mM salt stress. Salt tolerance exhibits an additive effect from favorable haplotypes, which are most abundant in Chinese accessions. GWAS-associated genes are related to key regulators of hormone signaling and osmotic adjustment, while transcriptome analysis indicates a global repression of stress-responsive transcription factors. Integrating these multi-omics datasets allows us to identify 14 candidate genes, including MsHSD1 (seed dormancy) and MsMTATP6 (energy metabolism). Crucially, incorporating these markers into genomic prediction models improve cross-population predictive accuracy to an average of 54.4%. This study provides insights into the genetic architecture of salt tolerance in alfalfa and offers valuable markers to facilitate molecular breeding.
abstract_zh: 紫花苜蓿（Medicago sativa L.）早期耐盐性的遗传基础，作为限制其生产力的关键因素，至今仍知之甚少。为解析这一复杂性状，我们在基于机器学习的基因组预测框架内，整合了来自176份种质的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和转录组学数据。分析揭示了四种耐盐性状间微弱的遗传相关性，以及随着盐胁迫增强而逐渐下降的表现。GWAS鉴定出60个显著关联的SNP，其中在100 mM盐胁迫下检测到的数量最多。耐盐性表现出有利单倍型的加性效应，这些单倍型在中国种质中最为丰富。GWAS关联基因涉及激素信号传导和渗透调节的关键调控因子，而转录组分析则表明胁迫响应转录因子存在全局性抑制。整合这些多组学数据集使我们鉴定出14个候选基因，包括MsHSD1（种子休眠）和MsMTATP6（能量代谢）。关键的是，将这些标记纳入基因组预测模型，可将跨群体预测准确率平均提高至54.4%。本研究为紫花苜蓿耐盐性的遗传结构提供了见解，并提供了有价值的标记以促进分子育种。
